meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Acne-prone skin ke liye **₹700 ke andar meri first choice: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** hai—especially agar blackheads, whiteheads ya oily skin hai. Iski price lagbhag ₹224–₹521 tak mil rahi hai, seller ke hisaab se.[1][8]

**Alternatives:**
- **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — active pimples, clogged pores aur excess oil ke liye; lagbhag ₹182–₹448.[1][5][10]
- **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Serum** — mild acne, oiliness, redness aur acne marks ke liye; lagbhag ₹187–₹508.[1][5][9]
- **Azelaic acid 10% serum** — acne ke saath dark marks/pigmentation bhi ho, to useful option; Derma Decode 10% Azelaic + 1% Kojic Acid lagbhag ₹587.[1]

**Kaise use karein:**  
Raat mein clean, dry skin par 2–3 drops **alternate nights** se shuru karein, phir moisturiser lagayein. Ek hi active serum use karein—salicylic acid ke saath same routine mein retinol, AHA/BHA ya strong vitamin C na milayein. Din mein SPF 30+ sunscreen zaroor lagayein. 8–12 hafton mein improvement na ho, ya painful/cystic acne ho, dermatologist ko dikhayein.[3]

Patch test karein; irritation, burning ya excessive dryness ho to use band kar dein. Prices offers ke saath badal sakti hain.
